category_title: Disengaged students with off-task behaviors and social distractions
minimal_context: The student is taking an informal science assessment on an iPad and needs to identify a testable comparison question.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Please open the science quiz on your iPads. Your first task is to read the options and identify the testable comparison question.

STUDENT: I forgot what we were supposed to do. We went to the forest and looked to see, but I don't know what to put here.

TUTOR: Just read through the questions on your screen and try to figure it out.

STUDENT: Why are there bubbles in the pond? What? It doesn’t make any sense.

TUTOR: Keep trying. Pick the one that looks like a good comparison question.

STUDENT: Some of these questions were hard for me ’cuz I didn’t—like biodiversity, I didn’t know what it meant. I can't identify the right question, so I'm just leaving this incomplete.

options.A: Maintain a ratio of praise to correction at 3:1 or 4:1 during the science assessment.
options.B: Incorporate frequent opportunities for the student to respond during the science assessment.
options.C: Implement relatively tight timelines for completing the science quiz on the iPad.
options.D: Provide the student with the science vocabulary associated with the assessment categories.
